title: Semiring identities in the semigroup $B_2$
summary: The 5-element Brandt semigroup $B_2$ admits the structure of a naturally semilattice-ordered inverse semigroup, thus becoming an additively idempotent semiring with the operation of taking greatest lower bounds as the semiring addition. For this semiring we present a finite basis of identities and thus, by the previous results, complete the solution of Finite Basis Problem for combinatorial naturally semilattice-ordered inverse semigroups.
